name: Table
description: A framework-free Web Component that frames a native table, adds three-state sorting and a three-state header checkbox, and makes the scroll region reachable by keyboard only while it actually overflows.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A captioned table with scoped headers and nothing that depends on script.

variants.name: Sortable
variants.description: Columns cycling through ascending, descending, and back to the order the data arrived in.

variants.name: Selectable
variants.description: Row selection driving a header checkbox that has a third, partly-selected state.

variants.name: Sticky
variants.description: A header that keeps its place, and its underline, while the rows scroll beneath it.

variants.name: Expandable
variants.description: Rows opening a real detail row that spans the columns and keeps its place in the reading order.

variants.name: Dense
variants.description: Compact rows in a table wider than its column, where the scroll region becomes a keyboard target.
